# Fixture PDFs

Run `pnpm generate:fixtures` to create deterministic PDF fixtures in `tests/fixtures/generated`.

The generator writes:
- `single-page.pdf`
- `multi-page.pdf`
- `engineering-large.pdf`
- `rotated-page.pdf`
- `mixed-page-sizes.pdf`

The generated manifest lives at `tests/fixtures/generated/manifest.json`.
